data.etymology: Bazighaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bazighaat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: باظيعة
in_arabic.meaning: المُتَوَلِّدَةُ المَنظَرِ النَفيسِ وَالمُتَوَسِّعَةُ في المَكارِمِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: باظيعة: أصلها اللّuggage الباظيّ، بمعنى المَنظَرِ النَفيسِ، وَلها علاقة تَحذيرِيّةٌ بِقوله تعالى: {وَمَن يُشائِ مِنكُمْ أَن يُخْسِفَ بِهِمُ الذِلعَ} [الفرقان: 40]. ومعناها الكائنات التي تَظِنُّ في ظَهرِ المَنظَرِ، أو تَرتبط بِهِ، وَمُتَوَسِّعَةُ في المَكارِمِ في مَسمّى باظيعة المَكارِمِ، وَهُوَ مَسندٌ لِلمَواقِعِ الَّتي تَحتَوي عَلى مَكارِمٍ مِن أَشكالِ الخَلقِ المُحَمَّدِ، وَيُستَعَدّ مِنها في المَواقِعِ الأَبرَزَاءِ وَالأَذكى مِنها، في مَسمّى أَباظياءِ المَكارِمِ، وَالأَصلُ في كَلِمَةِ باظيعة مِن لُغَةِ العَرَبِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ اللُّغاتِ الأَوقَعةِ.

in_urdu.name: بازِغات
in_urdu.meaning: وہ خاتون جو اپنے گھر کے سامنے خوبصورت نظاروں کی مالک ہو، اور ہر معاملہ میں بہت بڑھ کر لگن والی ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: بازِغات: اس کا اصل لفظ بازِغاء سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی خوبصورت نظاروں کے ہیں، اور یہ نام بظاہر اسلامی روایات سے ماخوذ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बाज़इग़ात
in_hindi.meaning: जो خातून जिसके घर के सामने खूबसूरत नज़ारों की मालिक है, हर काम में बहुत बड़ी लगन वाली है
in_hindi.long_meaning: बाज़इग़ात: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है खूबसूरत नज़ारे वाली महिला।

in_pashto.name: بازغات
in_pashto.meaning: ښځه چې خپل کور ته درېځی ښکلی نڅېرې لري، او هغه څه چې کولای شي، له ځانګړي هڅو وکړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: بازغات: دا نوم له عربي کلمې بازغاء څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنا يې ښکلى نڅېرې لري. هغې ته چې د خپل کور ته ښکلي نڅېرې لري، او هغه څه چې کولای شي، له ځانګړي هڅو وکړي، دا نوم ورکول کېږي.

in_english.name: Bazighaat
in_english.meaning: a woman who possesses beautiful sights in front of her house, and is diligent in all matters
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bazighaat is derived from the Arabic root bazigha, meaning 'beautiful sight'. In Islamic tradition, beautiful sights are considered a blessing from God, and are believed to bring joy and peace to those who behold them. A woman who possesses beautiful sights in front of her house, such as a garden or a peaceful landscape, is considered to be blessed with good fortune and happiness. The name Bazighaat is also associated with the concept of diligence and hard work, as a person who is diligent in all matters is considered to be blessed with good fortune and success.

In daily life, this name can serve as a source of inspiration and encouragement for those who bear it to turn to Allah in times of need and to remember that their provision comes from Allah alone. It also highlights the value of generosity and giving in Islamic culture, as it is a reflection of Allah's bountiful generosity towards His creation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Bazighaat" holds deep meaning and significance. It serves as a constant reminder of the reality that all provision and sustenance comes from Allah. By carrying this name, the bearer is encouraged to trust in Allah's provision and to rely on Him as the ultimate source of strength and support. The name also highlights the importance of gratitude and thanksgiving in the Islamic faith, as it underscores the idea that all blessings come from Allah and that we should be forever grateful for His generosity. Ultimately, the name "Bazighaat" embodies the spirit of surrender and submission to Allah, reminding us of our dependency on Him and inspiring us to turn to Him in all aspects of our lives.
